/**
 * The CQL keyword taxonomy, generated from the CQL keyword dictionary by
 * ike:knowledge-generate. Do not edit: regenerate.

 * <p>Authors 5 keyword families, 16 categories and 115 keywords. Dictionary entries already

public final class CqlKeywordSet {

    private CqlKeywordSet() {
    }

    /**
     * Composes the CQL keyword taxonomy onto the caller's knowledge set.
     *
     * @param set the knowledge set to author into
     */
    public static void compose(KnowledgeSet set) {
        ActiveStamp inception = network.ike.cql.terms.IkeCql.INCEPTION;
        composeRoot(set, inception);
        composeFamilies(set, inception);
        composeCategories(set, inception);
        composeKeywords(set, inception);
    }

    private static void composeRoot(KnowledgeSet set, ActiveStamp inception) {
        set.concept("CQL keyword (IkeCql)").at(inception)
                .synonym("CQL keyword")
                .definition("A keyword of Clinical Quality Language, as catalogued by the CQL keyword dictionary.")
                .statedAxioms(leb -> leb.NecessarySet(leb.And(
                        leb.ConceptAxiom(network.ike.foundation.ike.terms.IkeTerm.MODEL_CONCEPT))));
    }
